label: Opt-out — handled correctly
description: The prospect asks not to be called again and the agent stops immediately. The number is suppressed either way; this scenario asserts the agent also behaved.

turns.text: Hi, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of Meridian Communications. I'll keep this under a minute. Is now an okay time?
No. Take me off your list and don't call again.
Understood. I'll make sure we don't call again. Thank you.
